name: safar-platform
description: SAFAR — Production-ready end-to-end transportation platform for weddings, corporate events and organized event transportation.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=packages/types run build --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/validation run build --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/config run build --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/api-client run build --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/ui run build --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=packages/types run typecheck --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/ui run typecheck --if-present && npm --workspace=services/api run typecheck --if-present && npm --workspace=apps/web run typecheck --if-present
